Technical Specification 3.0.3

chain: knowledge gap re: CREFS operability [cause A] -> failure to engage additional resources -> inaccurate risk perception during cross-train surveillance -> Control Damper XDP0022A failed to close on demand -> A train CREFS inoperable while B train out for maintenance -> both trains of CREFS inoperable / loss of control room emergency filtration capability (10h52m) [no operable backup train available during window]
notes: Narrative attributes cause to three related personnel-error factors (knowledge gap, failure to escalate, inaccurate risk perception during surveillance planning); modeled as three sequential FailureMode nodes preceding the physical damper failure, consistent with cause_code A (Personnel Error) governing category. B train CREFS was out for planned maintenance (not an available operable backup) so no BACKED_UP_BY edge is asserted; both trains were simultaneously unavailable during the event window, which is the core reportable safety consequence.
